metadata.summary: Dataset of 1,204 abdominal and thoracic CT images with manual segmentations of 104 anatomical structures, including organs, bones, muscles, and vessels, retrospectively collected at the University Hospital Basel.
metadata.purpose: Benchmark and pretraining resource for medical image segmentation.

papers.title: TotalSegmentator: Robust segmentation of 104 anatomical structures in CT images

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.

known_limitations: No demographic metadata (age, sex, ethnicity) reported.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Single-center Swiss cohort; unknown demographic representativeness.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Limited generalizability beyond abdominal/thoracic CT from similar scanner protocols and populations.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Demographic and clinical metadata not provided.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Retrospectively collected abdominal and thoracic CT images.

population.target_population: Patients undergoing abdominal and thoracic CT imaging.
